title: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated to Supreme Court Rules by Article 93-3 (5) and (7) of the Military Court Act and other matters necessary for the perusal and copying of judgment documents, etc. under Article 93-3 of the Act. [Amended on June 30, 2022.]
